query: My 73‑year‑old man with lower GI bleeding: among male inpatients aged 68–78, what is the 90th‑percentile 72‑h lab‑instability score? For top‑tier patients, report mortality, average LOS, and compare critical rates for Cr, K, platelets, Hgb, whole‑blood K, and WBC versus all inpatients.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) AS instability_score, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.drg_mortality = 'Y' THEN l.subject_id END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, AVG(l.los) AS average_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN d.drg_code IN ('Cr', 'K', 'platelets', 'Hgb', 'whole blood K', 'WBC') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.subject_id), 0) AS specialized_care_rate FROM labevents l JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON l.subject_id = d.subject_id AND l.hadm_id = d.hadm_id WHERE l.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM male_patients) AND l.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM high_risk_patients) UNION ALL SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) AS instability_score, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.drg_mortality = 'Y' THEN l.subject_id END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, AVG(l.los) AS average_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN d.drg_code IN ('Cr', 'K', 'platelets', 'Hgb', 'whole blood K', 'WBC') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.subject_id), 0) AS specialized_care_rate FROM labevents l JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON l.subject_id = d.subject_id AND l.hadm_id = d.hadm_id WHERE l.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM male_patients) AND l.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM high_risk_patients);
